op_types.execute: Call connection.execute(sql, params?) — no result expected
op_types.executemany: Call connection.executemany(sql, param_seq) — no result expected
op_types.query: Call cursor.execute(sql, params?), then cursor.fetchall(); compare columns and rows
op_types.fetchone_test: Call cursor.execute(sql); call fetchone() twice; compare each row
op_types.fetchmany_test: Call cursor.execute(sql); call fetchmany(size) twice; compare each batch
op_types.fetchall_test: Call cursor.execute(sql); call fetchall(); compare all rows
op_types.fetchall_empty_test: Call cursor.execute(sql); call fetchall(); expect empty result

error_types.ProgrammingError: Wrong parameter count, invalid SQL syntax, or other client-side misuse

type_notes: NULL in expected_rows is the language-native null/nil/None/null value
Numeric values in expected_rows are integers unless stated otherwise
